description: RESEARCH CORPUS COVERAGE METRICS, NOT TOTAL RUSSIAN MARKET SIZE, SALES OR MARKET SHARE
caveat: The 2024 and 2025 UDS tender dates are submission DEADLINES, not publication dates; inferred manufacturer quantities and MW ratings prohibited. The 2025 6+10 kV item is one notice with two voltage models; its scalar equipment_voltage_kv intentionally null, both values in equipment_voltage_kv_set. Most older records do not normalize voltage even if described in text. NMC cannot be summed as PQ sales because mixed and non-target notices coexist.
